chunks.text:
[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: A minor with a heroic lift to C major
fast syncopated sawtooth lead melody with leaping hooks
relentless pumping root-fifth eighth-note synth bass
punchy sampled battle drums with snare fills
stabbing sampled brass answering the lead
urgent exciting creature battle theme, thrilling but winnable, never scary
seamless transition back to the theme
